//tier3: Tier 3 = the loop may ATTEMPT cards whose fix lives in src/ or scripts/ (owner-approved 2026-07-25, plan v2). It does NOT widen what merges without a human: src//scripts/ paths are never deterministic-green, so every tier-3 diff still lands on the morning approval tap. Turned on as the LAST commit of Sprints 2-4, after the shared check gauntlet (scripts/lib/autonomous-checks.js) and the merge-parity fix were in place — before those, a tier-3 branch could be implemented but never merged. tier3MaxItems caps how many code cards one night may attempt; start at 3 and watch the first few mornings. To turn it off: set tier3Enabled false (no code change, no redeploy). tier3BuildCheck false drops the production build from the src/ check set if it proves too slow.
//ownerEmail: null here (public repo) — the OWNER_EMAIL env var in .env is the real value; config value, if set, overrides
//attemptMemoryMaxFailures: Loop re-enable readiness (owner mandate 2026-07-30, task #635, do-not-re-enable marker #599 'groundhog day'): a card that fails this many times IN A ROW with unchanged text is parked (scripts/lib/attempt-memory.js) and skipped at triage — no LLM call, no attempt — until the owner edits it or clears the park (data/audit/attempt-memory-overrides.json). Matches the lib's own default; set explicitly here so raising/lowering it is a one-line config change, not a code change.
//circuitBreakerUSD: Spend circuit breaker (task #635, extends the existing nightUSD/weeklyUSD clamps in scripts/lib/autonomous-budget.js — spendCircuitBreakerStatus): re-checked before every card attempt tonight; if the running total across THIS run's implement events reaches this many dollars with ZERO cards reaching completed+verified (card-pass/auto-approve), the run halts for the night rather than keep burning through the same failure mode. null = never halts (today's behavior, and the loop is still paused per task #599 regardless). Deliberately left null/off pending the owner's shadow-mode review — do NOT set a value or flip launchd back on without that sign-off; see the card's Outcome for the recommended starting value (~$20, roughly 3 S-card or one M-card worst case) once shadow-mode evidence is in.
